description: This file is a shell script intended for system monitoring and logging CPU, memory, disk, and swap usage on a Linux-based system. It collects and logs system metrics, sends notifications via a telemetry client, and conditionally executes based on system state and uptime.

methods.name: t2ValNotify
methods.description: Sends a notification with a marker and additional arguments to the telemetry client.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in 'YYYY:MM:DD:HH:MM:SS' format.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns the current date and time with nanoseconds in 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS:6N' format.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific field from a string based on a delimiter.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two extracted CPU stat fields.
